title: perf: copy and hash historical replay inputs in one pass
body:
## Summary

Historical replay setup copies every tracked file and then reopens each destination to hash it. Copy and hash the same source bytes in one pass, retaining independent writable files, authenticated historical replacements and the complete final destination check.

```diff
- copyfile(source, target)
- sha256(target.read_bytes())
+ data = source.read_bytes()
+ require(target.write_bytes(data) == len(data))
+ sha256(data)
```

Add a source-pinned benchmark, three behavior tests and a scoped evidence package in `research/historical-snapshot-one-pass/`. This refines revision 5's `replay-runtime` card. Coordination: [Discussion #2732](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2732). Dennis's historical overlay implementation and the retained contributor lineage remain credited.

## Evidence

- **Before:** median setup 7.625 seconds. **After:** 5.391 seconds, 1.41 times faster and about 29% less setup time. Three alternating pairs on macOS arm64 / Python 3.12.15 used the same 45,160-file, 2.27 GB fixture. Every complete hash map agreed and every destination was independently rehashed outside the timer. This measures setup only.
- All 16 overlay tests and 5 isolated-runner caller tests pass. New controls cover binary/large/empty files, independent writes, short writes and write errors. Python 3.14 overlay checks, registered package replay, Ruff and an independent source/artifact review also pass. The complete R420 historical CLI replay passes with its four tests and final artifact gate.
- Two inherited CLI failures remain visible: skip-clones rejects `scripts/partial_swap/shared.py`, also reproduced with the untouched baseline runner; reconciliation92 rejects `scripts/run_parallel.py`. Both inputs equal their baseline Git bytes and differ from historical pins. `VALIDATION.json` records exact hashes. Neither failure is counted as a pass.

The benchmark baseline is main `bcdf338bf10ed70f1b3a0325fdd429677920d089`. The final upstream checkpoint is `5c2ad4fcded5fe44b12d192150bd0ab6af3cc3f3`, with unchanged relevant guidance and touched paths; merge-tree compatibility passes. Fresh overlap covers 757 open PRs and 1,358 discussion records with complete pagination. Pending #2579 and #2625 concern different runner completion/cancellation behavior.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** historical replay setup

Whole-file buffering remains; the measured largest source is 67.6 MB, released before reading the next. Linux/Windows performance and the full selected cold replay were not tested. Mathematical checks, frozen sources and the selected frontier are unchanged. Open next questions and reproduction commands are in the package README.
